    int x, y, limit;

    const double eps = 0.000000000000001;

        double scaled = ((double)x * d) / (double)y;

        Candidate selected = (highCand.error < lowCand.error) ? highCand : lowCand;

        if (selected.error < best.error - eps) {
            best = selected;
        }

    cout << best.num << '/' << best.den;
    return 0;
